# TestScript for 25-flat-completion-subcommand
# Asserts flat CLI opting into CompletionCommand:
# 1. Commands: section displays completion.
# 2. The --completion flag is suppressed from --help.

# 1. Opt-in CompletionCommand: --help displays Commands: section and suppresses --completion flag
exec runner --help
stdout 'Usage:\n  runner <task> \[flags\.\.\.\]'
stdout 'Commands:'
stdout 'completion\s+Generate shell completion script'
! stdout '--completion'

# 2. Opt-in CompletionCommand: completion subcommand generates completion scripts
exec runner completion bash
stdout '_runner_completion'
stdout 'complete -o noquote -F _runner_completion runner'

exec runner completion zsh
stdout '#compdef runner'
stdout '_runner_completion'

# 3. Opt-in CompletionCommand: unknown shell returns exit code 2 (usage error)
exit-status 2 runner completion invalidshell
stderr 'unknown shell "invalidshell"'

# 4. Opt-in CompletionCommand: normal command execution
exec runner build
stdout 'Running task build \(dry-run=false\)'
